name: The Travelers Companies, Inc.
summary: The Travelers Companies, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides a range of commercial and personal property, and casualty insurance products and services to businesses, government units, associations, and individuals in the United States, Canada, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Business Insurance, Bond & Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance. The Business Insurance
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 5/7 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 78/100 (Starker Buffett-Kandidat), Innovations-Score 20/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 608.48 USD (+52 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
